sponsored.t: Provides that the additional sales tax that Cortland county is authorized to impose shall not be subject to preemption
sponsored.sum: Provides that the additional rate of sales and compensating use tax imposed by Cortland county shall not be subject to preemption.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Cortland to transfer ownership of Linear Park to Lime Hollow Nature Center, Inc.
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Cortland to transfer ownership of Linear Park to Lime Hollow Nature Center, Inc.; provides that such lands shall revert to the county of Cortland if they cease to be used for the agreed upon purpose; provides that such park shall continue to be made available to the general public of the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions authorizing hunting big game by rifle in the county of Tompkins
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions authorizing hunting big game by rifle in the county of Tompkins until 2028.

sponsored.t: Relates to the allocation and use of the revenues raised from the imposition of hotel and motel taxes in Cortland county
sponsored.sum: Relates to the allocation and use of the revenues raised from the imposition of hotel and motel taxes in Cortland county; provides that a certain percentage of such net annual occupancy receipts be utilized to support and enhance tourism and tourist activity; provides that the remaining portion be used for any lawful county purpose related to economic development.

sponsored.t: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Ithaca
sponsored.sum: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Ithaca; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2030.

sponsored.t: Establishes the home kitchen enterprise and economic opportunity act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the home kitchen enterprise and economic opportunity act; relates to the licensing and operation of home kitchen operations which store, handle, prepare and package ready-to-eat food for consumers.

sponsored.t: Authorizes camp operators and employees who are 18 years of age or older to administer medications and treatment to children under certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Allows camp employees who are 18 years of age or older to administer medications and treatment to children, under parent or guardian consent and authorization, pursuant to a patient specific order and in compliance with regulations.

sponsored.t: Provides for insurance coverage of comprehensive annual medical examinations for firefighters
sponsored.sum: Provides for insurance coverage of comprehensive annual medical examinations for firefighters due to their increased risk for cancer and cancer-related diseases.

sponsored.t: Requires certain utility corporations and the Long Island power authority to establish a meter usage monitor program
sponsored.sum: Requires certain utility corporations and the Long Island power authority to establish a meter usage monitor program for the purposes of notifying residential customers when energy usage exceeds a cost or usage threshold in a given billing period determined by the residential customer.

sponsored.t: Authorizes individuals receiving hospice services to enroll in managed long term care plans
sponsored.sum: Permits individuals receiving hospice services to enroll in managed long term care plans; ensures coordinated service delivery.

sponsored.t: Relates to permits and financial security for reclamation for mining on state-owned lands occurring below or beneath navigable waters; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to permits and financial security for reclamation for mining on state-owned lands occurring below or beneath navigable waters; requires such permits to be subject to environmental quality review procedures; requires financial security to cover any damages directly or indirectly resulting from mining activities on state-owned lands occurring below or beneath navigable waterways, including, but not limited to, those resulting from collapse or water contamination.

sponsored.t: Relates to the administration of reversible progestin-only contraceptive injections
sponsored.sum: Relates to the administration of reversible progestin-only contraceptive injections; provides that no pharmacist shall administer reversible progestin-only contraceptive injections without receiving training satisfactory to the commissioner of education and the commissioner of health.

sponsored.t: Requires the office of children and family services to notify child day care providers of updates on any forms listed on their website
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of children and family services to provide written and electronic notice to child day care providers whenever such office has updated any form necessary for the delivery of services listed on its website; provides that such notice shall be disseminated in concurrence with the publication of updated forms.

sponsored.t: Requires medical assistance to include medical care, services or supplies to monitor blood pressure that have been validated for accuracy and are furnished without prior authorization to eligible pregnant women
sponsored.sum: Requires medical assistance to include medical care, services or supplies to monitor blood pressure that have been validated for accuracy and are furnished without prior authorization to eligible pregnant women.

sponsored.t: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the city of Ithaca
sponsored.sum: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the city of Ithaca.

sponsored.t: Permits the Vestal Central School District to create an insurance reserve fund
sponsored.sum: Permits the Vestal Central School District to create an insurance reserve fund.

sponsored.t: Permits the Chenango Forks central school district to create an insurance reserve fund
sponsored.sum: Permits the Chenango Forks central school district to create an insurance reserve fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to the central New York regional transportation authority
sponsored.sum: Increases the membership of the central New York regional transportation authority from twelve to thirteen members.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Johnson City to establish hotel and motel taxes within such village
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Johnson City to establish hotel and motel taxes within such village.
sponsored.fis: To be determined. This legislation will have no fiscal implications for State Government and will raise additional revenue for the village of Johnson City.

sponsored.t: Establishes the mental health educational opportunity program and the mental health higher educational opportunity program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the mental health educational opportunity program and the mental health higher educational opportunity program to provide additional educational opportunities for students at certain universities and colleges in the state to enroll in academic programs that lead to a degree or degrees required for licensure in any of the mental health professions.

sponsored.t: Enacts the student voter empowerment act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "student voter empowerment act"; requires each institution of higher education to designate a staff member to act as a student voting coordinator; requires such coordinator to develop and implement a student voting action plan to increase student voter registration and voting and democratic participation among students.

sponsored.t: Relates to license requirements for professional geologists; repealer
sponsored.sum: Provides that the education requirements to be licensed as a professional geologist may be partially substituted by practical experience; relates to the issuance of an identification card as a geologist in training.

sponsored.t: Enacts the college student suicide prevention act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the college student suicide prevention act to provide for policies, procedures and guidelines on suicide prevention, intervention and postvention for every higher education institution.

sponsored.t: Relates to participation in World Trade Center rescue, recovery and cleanup operations by members of the organized militia
sponsored.sum: Relates to participation in World Trade Center rescue, recovery and cleanup operations by members of the organized militia; provides that members of the organized militia shall qualify as employees for the purposes of making a claim under the workers' compensation law for participation in the World Trade Center rescue, recovery and cleanup operations.

sponsored.t: Requires a lethality assessment in incidents of domestic violence
sponsored.sum: Requires law enforcement officers to conduct a lethality assessment as part of the standardized domestic incident report form when responding to incidents of domestic violence.

sponsored.t: Requires signage be placed alongside art and artifacts stolen during the transatlantic slave period and the domestic slave trade period indicating such material was stolen
sponsored.sum: Requires signage be placed alongside art and artifacts, including art and artifacts created using metal materials used in the exchange for enslaved human captives, which were stolen during the transatlantic slave period and the domestic slave trade period, between the 16th and 19th centuries, with its peak between 1700 and 1870, indicating such information.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to establish and maintain a menopause informational and resource webpage on the department website
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to establish and maintain a menopause informational and resource webpage on the department website.

sponsored.t: Provides for the expansion of regional farmers' markets
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of agriculture and markets to increase the number of regional farmers' markets for the direct marketing of foods and produce produced in the state.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "ATV, UTV, ROV safe riding protection act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "ATV, UTV, ROV safe riding protection act"; provides for the registration and operation of utility task vehicles.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of a "ebony alert system" for missing Black youth
sponsored.sum: Provides for the creation of an ebony alert system to be activated on behalf of Black youth who are reported missing under unexplained or suspicious circumstances, at risk, developmentally disabled, or cognitively impaired, or who have been abducted.

sponsored.t: Establishes a narcolepsy and sleep disorder education and awareness program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a narcolepsy and sleep disorder education and awareness program to reduce stigma and promote screening, diagnosis, and management through evidence-based treatment and medication for narcolepsy and other sleep disorders.

sponsored.t: Authorizes counties to post local laws and notices via the internet
sponsored.sum: Authorizes counties to post local laws and notices via the internet where such county doesn't have a newspaper published within the county.

sponsored.t: Relates to preventing discrimination and increasing awareness of rights for employees with menstrual-related conditions, perimenopausal-related conditions and menopausal-related conditions
sponsored.sum: Relates to preventing discrimination and increasing awareness of rights for employees with menstrual-related conditions, perimenopausal-related conditions and menopausal-related conditions; requires employers to provide employees with an informational pamphlet on any regulations relating to the rights of employees.

sponsored.t: Authorizes high schools to include opioid overdose prevention and non-intravenous opioid antagonist administration as part of required health education courses
sponsored.sum: Authorizes high schools to include opioid overdose prevention and non-intravenous opioid antagonist administration as optional part of required health education courses; authorizes certain students to administer non-intravenous opioid antagonists.

sponsored.t: Requires certain health insurance coverage for prostheses and custom orthoses
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance coverage for prosthetic and orthotic devices that equals the coverage and payment provided for by federal laws and regulations for the aged and disabled.

sponsored.t: Provides for the issuance of birth certificates of a deceased parent to their child
sponsored.sum: Provides for the issuance of birth certificates of a deceased parent to their child.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the provision of child care services on school grounds during school and non-school hours
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the provision of child care services on school grounds during school and non-school hours.

sponsored.t: Adds CLN2, MPS IVA, MPS VI, MPS VII and Fabry diseases to the newborn screening panel for New York state
sponsored.sum: Adds CLN2, MPS IVA, MPS VI, MPS VII and Fabry diseases to the newborn screening panel for New York state; requires tests be made available within twelve months.

sponsored.t: Permits the Johnson City Central school district to create an insurance reserve fund
sponsored.sum: Permits the Johnson City central school district to create an insurance reserve fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to the terms of office of commissioners of elections
sponsored.sum: Increases the term of office of an election commissioner from two to four years beginning January first of each odd numbered year.

sponsored.t: Relates to forfeiture of a beneficiary's right to benefits upon conviction of a family offense
sponsored.sum: Permits a retired member to change their option election or designate a new beneficiary where the beneficiary has been convicted of a family offense.

sponsored.t: Expands the Tompkins county industrial development agency from seven to nine members
sponsored.sum: Expands the Tompkins county industrial development agency from a maximum of seven members to nine members.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "beauty justice act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "beauty justice act"; provides for the regulation of ingredients in personal care products and cosmetics; prohibits the sale of personal care products and cosmetic products containing certain restricted products.

sponsored.t: Enacts the HOPE pilot program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Enacts the HOPE pilot program; allows households to apply for multiple food and anti-poverty benefits simultaneously online and enable families to work with nonprofit and government agencies to enact action plans to boost their long-term self-sufficiency.

sponsored.t: Authorizes funding to local government entities from the urban development corporation
sponsored.sum: Authorizes funding to local government entities from the urban development corporation through the electric generation facility cessation mitigation fund for an additional three years.

sponsored.t: Establishes the office of global public health and international cooperation within the department of health
sponsored.sum: Establishes the office of global public health and international cooperation within the department of health to coordinate cooperation with international public health institutions for purposes related to public health; requires such office to submit an annual global health risk and preparedness report to the governor, the temporary president of the senate, the speaker of the assembly and the chairs of the senate and assembly health committees.

sponsored.t: Establishes the food price equity task force
sponsored.sum: Establishes the food price equity task force to study racialized food pricing disparities.
sponsored.fis: Fiscal implications are expected to be minimal. Members shall serve without compensation but may be reimbursed for necessary expenses. Staffing and support services shall be provided within existing appro- priations unless otherwise allocated.

sponsored.t: Requires coverage of a hospitalized birthing parent's interhospital transport to accompany their infant needing such transport
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance coverage of a hospitalized birthing parent's interhospital transport to accompany such birthing parent's newborn infant experiencing a condition necessitating transport.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to establish and maintain a directory webpage locating publicly accessible lactation accommodations in state-owned and state-leased buildings
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health, in conjunction with other state agencies, to establish and maintain a directory webpage locating publicly accessible lactation accommodations in state-owned and state-leased buildings.

sponsored.t: Relates to review of projects affecting the availability of maternity services
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of health to promulgate regulations requiring that the addition of, decertification of, or changes in the method of delivery of perinatal services by a general hospital be subject to an application under article 28 of the public health law that requires review and approval by the council.

sponsored.t: Relates to dental laboratories
sponsored.sum: Relates to dental laboratories; defines terms; requires any dental laboratory operating, doing business, or intending to operate or do business in this state to register with the department of health; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Allows Ivan Cruz to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of deputy sheriff for the Broome county sheriff's office
sponsored.sum: Allows Ivan Cruz to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of deputy sheriff for the Broome county sheriff's office.

sponsored.t: Allows Ivan Cruz to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of police officer for the Ithaca police department
sponsored.sum: Allows Ivan Cruz to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of police officer for the Ithaca police department.

sponsored.t: Allows Ivan Cruz to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of deputy sheriff for the Tompkins county sheriff's office
sponsored.sum: Allows Ivan Cruz to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of deputy sheriff for the Tompkins county sheriff's office.

sponsored.t: Allows Ivan Cruz to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of police officer for the Broome county department of personnel
sponsored.sum: Allows Ivan Cruz to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of police officer for the Broome county department of personnel.

sponsored.t: Relates to obtaining certain employment and income data of individuals eligible for medical assistance
sponsored.sum: Relates to the commissioner of health obtaining certain employment and income data of individuals eligible for medical assistance.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing bed and breakfasts to sell cider, liquor, beer and wine
sponsored.sum: Relates to allowing bed and breakfasts to sell cider, liquor, beer and wine on the licensed premises.

sponsored.t: Requires general hospitals to have a registered professional nurse as a member of the governing entity responsible for developing a general hospital's strategic plan, structure, systems, policies and programs
sponsored.sum: Requires hospitals to have a registered professional nurse as a sitting and voting member of the governing entity responsible for developing a hospital's strategic plan, structure, systems, policies and programs.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a prenatal and postpartum informational mobile application
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a prenatal and postpartum informational mobile application for individuals who are eligible for Medicaid.
sponsored.fis: Potential cost savings to be expected from the expansion of important information to birthing individuals and a reduction in costly medical emergencies for both birthing individuals and babies.

sponsored.t: Relates to value-based care for maternity coverage
sponsored.sum: Requires contracts for insurance and medical assistance to provide value-based care for maternity coverage; defines value-based care as an arrangement that financially rewards certain positive outcomes and financially penalizes certain negative outcomes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes pharmacists to administer injections for contraceptive use
sponsored.sum: Authorizes pharmacists to administer injections for contraceptive use.

sponsored.t: Requires each institution within the state university of New York and the city university of New York to have at least one vending machine making emergency contraception available for purchase
sponsored.sum: Requires each institution within the state university of New York and the city university of New York offering in-person student instruction to have at least one vending machine making emergency contraception available for purchase.

sponsored.t: Relates to the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to excluding certain food donations from sales tax
sponsored.sum: Relates to the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to excluding certain food donations from sales tax to July 1, 2026.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain information to be included in the annual report from the division of minority and women's business development
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring that the annual report from the division of minority and women's business development contain information on the annual minority and women-owned business enterprise utilization and expenditure categorized by minority-owned enterprises, women-owned enterprises, and total utilization and expenditure, and be organized by certain industry categories.

sponsored.t: Prohibits state contracts with contractors who do not provide health insurance which covers supplemental breast cancer screenings
sponsored.sum: Prohibits state contracts with contractors who do not provide health insurance which covers supplemental breast cancer screenings; authorizes the comptroller to promulgate any necessary rules and regulations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the term "reportable business relationship" as it relates to certain employees of the state university of New York and the city university of New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to the term "reportable business relationship" as it relates to certain employees of the state university of New York and the city university of New York.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of transportation to establish a central registry of reports, audits, plans and public inspections for freight rail operators, rail cars and freight lines
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of transportation to establish a central registry of reports, audits, plans and public inspections regarding freight rail operators, rail cars and freight lines or routes and rights of way.

sponsored.t: Enacts "SUNY for all: the New York State higher education equality act" to provide free tuition to students who attend SUNY
sponsored.sum: Enacts "new deal for SUNY: the New York state higher education equality act" to provide free tuition to students who attend SUNY who are enrolled in academic coursework and are on track to graduate; establishes the state university tuition fund to reimburse the state university of New York for the cost of tuition for students who are eligible for free tuition.

sponsored.t: Relates to school district unexpended surplus funds
sponsored.sum: Relates to school district unexpended surplus funds; provides that for the 2027--2028 school year and thereafter, surplus funds shall mean any operating funds in excess of six percent of the current school year budget, and shall not include funds properly retained under other sections of law.

sponsored.t: Relates to permits and financial security for reclamation for salt mining beneath a lake
sponsored.sum: Relates to permits and financial security for reclamation for salt mining beneath a lake; requires such permits to be subject to environmental quality review procedures; requires financial security to cover any damages directly or indirectly resulting from salt mining activities beneath a lake, including, but not limited to, those resulting from collapse or water contamination.

sponsored.t: Relates to the fingerprinting of prospective child day care employees and sharing fingerprint results
sponsored.sum: Relates to the fingerprinting of prospective child day care employees and sharing fingerprint results.
sponsored.fis: Administrative savings to providers and state agencies.

sponsored.t: Authorizing the empire state development corporation to retain an independent MWBE consultant firm for the purpose of helping reduce contractor violations of the provisions of article 15-A of the executive law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to retain an independent MWBE consultant firm for the purpose of helping reduce contractor violations of the provisions of article 15-A of the executive law; requires contractors in violation of the provisions of article 15-A of the executive law to retain independent monitors to oversee compliance.

sponsored.t: Relates to a free or reduced meal plan for certain students enrolled at state and city universities
sponsored.sum: Directs the boards of trustees of SUNY and CUNY to create a free or reduced meal plan to aid students whose household incomes are below the federal poverty line, students participating in educational opportunity programs under section three hundred fifty-five-d of this article and students receiving federal Pell grants.

sponsored.t: Relates to limitations upon school district tax levies
sponsored.sum: Provides that the tax levy limit shall be equal to a zero percent increase over the prior year tax levy when the difference between the total amount of taxes levied for the prior year less the tax levy limit results in a negative number.

sponsored.t: Provides grant funding, where available, for broadband services in non-competitive locations
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Provides grant funding, where available, for broadband services in non-competitive locations through the ConnectAll deployment program.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing for prompt payment by contractors receiving public funds of amounts owed to small businesses and minority-owned business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Requires contractors receiving public funds to pay amounts owed to small businesses and minority-owned business enterprises within 10 days of receipt of an undisputed invoice generated by a small business, minority-owned business enterprise or vendor management service and managed service provider on behalf of the small business or minority-owned business enterprise.

sponsored.t: Establishes composting programs at state university of New York and city university of New York campuses
sponsored.sum: Requires the establishment of a composting program at the state university of New York, the city university of New York and institutions subject to the jurisdiction of SUNY or CUNY.

sponsored.t: Establishes a Black Leadership Institute within the state university of New York
sponsored.sum: Establishes a Black Leadership Institute within the state university of New York as an initiative for Black leaders in higher education with a mission to retain and grow from within SUNY a greater proportion of Black professionals at SUNY campuses; creates an eight member advisory council.

sponsored.t: Relates to licensing laser hair removal technicians
sponsored.sum: Relates to licensing laser hair removal technicians; establishes laser hair removal rules, regulations and standards.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain car-sharing organizations from the supplemental tax on passenger car rentals outside of the metropolitan commuter transportation district
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain non-profit car-sharing organizations from the supplemental tax on passenger car rentals outside of the metropolitan commuter transportation district.

sponsored.t: Directs the development of a demonstration program to authorize individuals aged sixteen and seventeen to be consumer directed personal assistants
sponsored.sum: Directs the development of a demonstration program to authorize individuals aged sixteen and seventeen to be consumer directed personal assistants.

sponsored.t: Relates to the practice of natural hair care and braiding
sponsored.sum: Relates to the practice of natural hair care and braiding; creates an apprenticeship in such area; makes conforming technical changes.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "safer health care facility construction act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "safer health care facility construction act"; requires the commissioner of health to adopt infection control risk assessment (ICRA) standards to reduce the risk from infection in all health care facilities; requires all construction work performed on a new health care facility and on the expansion of an existing health care facility to be compliant with ICRA standards; requires people performing construction work on a health care facility be certified in compliance with ICRA standards.

sponsored.t: Requires publications to identify when the use of artificial intelligence is present within such publication
sponsored.sum: Requires that every newspaper, magazine or other publication printed or electronically published in this state, which contains the use of generative artificial intelligence or other information communication technology, shall identify that certain parts of such newspaper, magazine, or publication were composed through the use of artificial intelligence or other information communication technology.

sponsored.t: Excludes a production using artificial intelligence or autonomous vehicles in a manner which results in the displacement of employees from the definition of qualified film
sponsored.sum: Excludes a production using artificial intelligence or autonomous vehicles in a manner which results in the displacement of employees whose salaries are qualified expenses from the definition of qualified film for the purposes of the empire state film production credit.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing student onboarding and ongoing education on reproductive health services
sponsored.sum: Requires student onboarding and ongoing education on reproductive health services available to students including where the closest reproductive health clinics are located; all resources available to a student seeking reproductive health services including but not limited to financial assistance and mental health services and any reproductive health resources available to a student through the institution.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring certain fees be deposited into the mental illness anti-stigma fund
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring application fees for the issuance of operating certificates be deposited into the mental illness anti-stigma fund.

sponsored.t: Establishes a state university of New York pilot program to encourage individuals in college to enter the financial planning industry
sponsored.sum: Establishes a state university of New York career pilot program to encourage individuals in college to enter the financial planning industry; utilizes campus resources to encourage a well-rounded program and diverse student involvement.

sponsored.t: Authorizes physicians and pharmacists to enter into collaborative practice medication adherence protocols for their patients
sponsored.sum: Authorizes physicians and pharmacists to enter into collaborative practice medication adherence protocols for their patients; makes permanent certain provisions relating to authorizing pharmacists to perform with physicians in certain settings.
sponsored.fis: This legislation is expected to result in a savings for the State under Medicaid and other public programs.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for long term medical care for Lyme disease and other tick borne related pathogens
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for long term medical care for Lyme disease and other tick borne related pathogens.

sponsored.t: Requires automated external defibrillator equipment to be immediately available at school-sponsored events
sponsored.sum: Requires automated external defibrillator equipment to be immediately available at school-sponsored events; requires school districts, boards of cooperative educational services, county vocational education and extension boards and charter schools to develop and implement a cardiac emergency response plan.

sponsored.t: Provides for reimbursement for child care absences
sponsored.sum: Relates to reimbursement criteria for child care absences.

sponsored.t: Increases the excelsior research and development tax credit
sponsored.sum: Increases the excelsior research and development tax credit maximum from six to twenty percent.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sale of personal information by an internet service provider
sponsored.sum: Relates to the sale of personal information by an internet service provider.

sponsored.t: Relates to state aid for home health care to meet community need
sponsored.sum: Provides for state aid for home health care and hospice services to meet community need.
sponsored.fis: There are anticipated Medicaid savings resulting from access to home health care necessary to avert preventable hospital, nursing home and emergency services and expenses, as well as to enable less costly ambu- latory surgical and interventional options for patient care.

sponsored.t: Relates to the rates of payment for certified home health agencies
sponsored.sum: Relates to the rates of payment for certified home health agencies.
sponsored.fis: This bill has no immediate fiscal impact

sponsored.t: Relates to domestic violence training for health and mental health professionals
sponsored.sum: Relates to domestic violence training for health and mental health professionals; requires such trainings to be updated annually by the commissioner of health in consultation with the office for the prevention of domestic violence; requires the commissioner of health to collect data on participation of such trainings by health professionals.

sponsored.t: Removes references to the terms "masseur" and "masseuse"
sponsored.sum: Removes references to the terms "masseur" and "masseuse".

sponsored.t: Provides for self-attestation for victims of domestic violence
sponsored.sum: Provides for self-attestation for victims of domestic violence.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Scott Pavlick to receive certain service credit under a twenty-five year retirement plan
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Scott Pavlick to receive certain service credit under a twenty-five year retirement plan offering one-sixtieths after twenty-five years of total creditable service for service with the Binghamton Fire Department.
sponsored.fis: If this bill is enacted during the 2025 Legislative Session, it is anticipated that there will be an increase of approximately $2,000 in an annual contributions of the City of Binghamton for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2026. In future years this cost will vary as the build- ing rates and salary of Scott Pavlick change. In addition to the annual contributions discussed above, there will be an immediate past service cost of approximately $33,200 which will be borne by the City of Binghamton as a one-time payment. This estimate assumes that payment will be made on February 1, 2026. If the City of Binghamton elects to amortize this cost over a 10-year period, the cost for each year including interest would be $4,240.

sponsored.t: Relates to the calculation of child support; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the calculation of child support; provides that child support amounts shall be calculated based on the non-custodial parent's income; excludes health insurance costs and federal and state income taxes paid from the calculation of income for child support calculation purposes; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Excludes certain food donations from sales tax
sponsored.sum: Excludes food sold to a student purchasing a meal using an approved donation program of funds or food points from sales tax.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 59 Chapter 678 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 2279, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the tax law, in relation to excluding certain food donations from sales tax" APPROVED This bill would amend the tax law to exempt meal swipe donations from sales tax for colleges, universities and other post-secondary school meal plans to facilitate the donation of unused meal plan meals to students facing food insecurity. Food insecurity is placing a strain on our nation. Many students have taken the initiative to help those facing hardship. Students should not have to struggle with hunger while pursuing an education. Everyone deserves access to food, which is why I fully support this bill. Howev- er, this bill needs a chapter amendment to resolve the tax-related issues associated with these donations. The Legislature has agreed to enact these changes, and so based on that…

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Trumansburg to offer an optional twenty-year retirement plan to a certain formerly employed police officer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Trumansburg to offer an optional twenty-year retirement plan to Kevin R. Noterfonzo under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Tompkins to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to Bryan Jolly, a deputy sheriff employed by such county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Tompkins to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to Bryan Jolly, a deputy sheriff employed by such county upon such officer's election to participate in such plan.
sponsored.fis: an increase of approximately $8,900 in the annual contributions of Tomp- kins County for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2026; immediate past service cost of approximately $69,380 to be borne by Tompkins County

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Tompkins to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to Kyle Davenport, a deputy sheriff employed by such county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Tompkins to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to Kyle Davenport, a deputy sheriff employed by such county upon such officer's election to participate in such plan.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Trumansburg to offer an optional twenty-year retirement plan to a certain formerly employed police officer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Trumansburg to offer an optional twenty-year retirement plan to Daniel H. Austic under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law.
sponsored.fis: This bill will require an increase of approximately $550 in the annual contributions of the Village of Trumansburg for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2026. In future years this cost will vary as the billing rates and salary of Daniel H. Austic change. In addition, there will be an immediate past service cost of approximately $3,090 which will be borne by the Village of Trumansburg as a one-time payment.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Trumansburg to offer an optional twenty-year retirement plan to a certain formerly employed police officer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Trumansburg to offer an optional twenty-year retirement plan to Mackenzie M. Covert under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law.
sponsored.fis: This bill will require an increase of approximately $10,000 in the annu- al contributions of the Village of Trumansburg for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2026. In future years this cost will vary as the bill- ing rates and salary of Mackenzie M. Covert change. In addition, there will be an immediate past service cost of approximately $139,000 which will be borne by the Village of Trumansburg as a one-time payment.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the discontinuance of certain parklands in the town of Cortlandville, county of Cortland
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the discontinuance of certain parklands in the town of Cortlandville, county of Cortland for lease to Park Outdoor Advertising of New York, Inc. for the purpose of erecting, maintaining and operating an electronic sign.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Broome to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization granted to the county of Broome to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes for two years.
sponsored.fis: This legislation will have no fiscal implications for the State.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Dickinson to establish hotel and motel taxes within such town
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Dickinson to establish hotel and motel taxes within such town.
sponsored.fis: This legislation will have no fiscal implications for the State. The bill will impose a 3% Occupancy tax on hotel/motel rooms in the town of Dickinson.

sponsored.t: Authorizes David Edwards to receive certain service credit under a twenty-five year retirement plan
sponsored.sum: Authorizes David Edwards to receive certain service credit under a twenty-five year retirement plan offering one-sixtieths after twenty-five years of total creditable service for service with the Binghamton Fire Department.
sponsored.fis: If this bill is enacted during the 2025 Legislative Session, it is anticipated that there will be an increase of approximately $1,100 in an annual contributions of the City of Binghamton for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2026. In future years this cost will vary as the build- ing rates and salary of David Edwards change. In addition to the annual contributions discussed above, there will be an immediate past service cost of approximately $16,700 which will be borne by the City of Binghamton as a one-time payment. This estimate assumes that payment will be made on February 1, 2026. If the City of Binghamton elects to amortize this cost over a 10-year Period, the cost for each year including interest would be $2,130.

sponsored.t: Relates to the requirements of the annual report from the division of minority and women's business development
sponsored.sum: Relates to the requirements of the annual report from the division of minority and women's business development; requires the number of new certifications and recertifications including the basis for any denials be included in the annual report from the division of minority and women's business development.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Ithaca, county of Tompkins to discontinue as parklands and alienate certain lands
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Ithaca, county of Tompkins, to discontinue as parklands and alienate certain lands for the purpose of maintaining and operating such lands for agricultural purposes.

sponsored.t: Relates to automatic orders in matrimonial actions
sponsored.sum: Sets the effectiveness and duration of automatic orders in matrimonial actions.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Tompkins to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Tompkins to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends provisions of law authorizing the county of Cortland to impose an additional mortgage recording tax
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of law authorizing the county of Cortland to impose an additional mortgage recording tax until December 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to continuing education requirements for landscape architects
sponsored.sum: Relates to continuing education requirements for landscape architects; provides that adjustments to such requirements may be granted for health reasons, active duty, or other good cause; limits the number of credit hours that may carry over to the next registration period.
sponsored.fis: This legislation will have no fiscal implications for State or local governments.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization for an additional sales tax in Cortland county
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization for an additional sales tax in Cortland county.

sponsored.t: Establishes a distinctive plate honoring recipients of the Girl Scout Gold Award
sponsored.sum: Establishes a distinctive plate honoring recipients of the Girl Scout Gold Award for which the regular registration fee will apply plus an initial one time service charge of $25.

sponsored.t: Relates to women's health in correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to women's health in correctional facilities; establishes a women's health education program; requires HIV and STD testing to be offered to incarcerated individuals; provides pregnant incarcerated individuals with access to prenatal vitamins as well as a specialized diet tailored to pregnancy needs; requires a study and report on women's health in prison.
sponsored.fis: , Costs are anticipated to be-approximately $970,000 to the state and local governments. Of this cost, the delivery of prenatal and gynecolog- ical care is estimated at $220,000 to state and local correctional facilities. The Department of Health has estimated the costs of the study at $750,000 that includes staffing, training development & admin- istration as well as data collection.

sponsored.t: Requires corporations and municipalities to notify property owners prior to beginning certain services
sponsored.sum: Requires corporations and municipalities to notify property owners prior to beginning services that may interfere with a property owner's ability to enjoy, use, or access such property owner's property; exempts cases where a natural or man-made disaster or state of emergency occurs.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a remote maternal health services pilot program for Medicaid recipients
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a remote maternal health services pilot program for Medicaid recipients; provides that such program shall be established during fiscal years 2025-2026, 2026-2027 and 2027-2028 to provide: remote maternal health services to eligible Medicaid recipients, medically necessary remote maternal health services to such eligible recipients for up to 12 months postpartum and payment to healthcare providers who provide remote maternal health services.
sponsored.fis: To be determined- however potential savings will result from better outcomes and reduced hospitalizations of high risk pregnant women.

sponsored.t: Relates to the payment of real property and school district taxes in installments
sponsored.sum: Clarifies disclosures for the payment of real property and school district taxes in installments.

sponsored.t: Relates to maternal health care and birthing best practices; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health to evaluate and make recommendations related to maternal health care and birthing best practices; repeals certain provisions.
